messages:
elaine (PM): quick sync — we need to settle sequencing for Q2 candidates. three proposals: Predictive Prefetch, Adaptive Batching, Model Pinning rollout. I sketched RICE numbers below, want fast gut-check and any hard constraints (customers, infra deps, launch gates).

matt (Eng): thanks. can we surface which ones block infra effort this quarter?

elaine (PM): Predictive Prefetch = platform-heavy (prefetch cache + heuristics). Adaptive Batching = runtime change + config UI. Model Pinning = policy/metadata + routing change, smaller surface but enterprise-critical.

jason (Product Ops): pasted quick RICE snapshot (rough):
```
Predictive Prefetch | Reach=30k Q users | Impact=0.8 | Confidence=0.6 | Effort=8 => RICE≈1800
Adaptive Batching   | Reach=20k        | Impact=0.6 | Confidence=0.7 | Effort=5 => RICE≈1680
Model Pinning       | Reach=5k         | Impact=1.5 | Confidence=0.9 | Effort=2 => RICE≈3375
```

sophia (Design): Model Pinning UX is small (pin toggle + audit view) but needs clear rollout messaging.

aiden (Infra): Predictive Prefetch has biggest infra lift (cache infra + extra ingress). can we defer if Pinning is urgent?

matt (Eng): technically, Prefetch could reduce downstream cost long-term, but effort is ~8 engineer-months. Adaptive Batching is middling effort and helps cost/latency for many customers.

elaine (PM): tradeoff: Model Pinning highest RICE but low reach — however Acme Health just flagged compliance deadline next month and will only sign once pinning exists.

jason (Product Ops): Acme Health ask: "model pinning + audit trail" — contract renewal dependency. internal legal flagged as blocker.

matt (Eng): if contractual, that moves pinning up regardless of reach. we can scope to MVP: per-org pin + simple routing, rollout in 2 sprints.

sophia (Design): agree MVP is small. we should include a design checklist: privacy copy, admin controls, audit export.

elaine (PM): potential sequencing options: 
- Option A: Model Pinning (fast win, satisfies Acme) -> Adaptive Batching -> Predictive Prefetch
- Option B: Adaptive Batching -> Predictive Prefetch -> Model Pinning (delays Acme)
- Option C: Parallel small teams: Pinning + Batching, Prefetch later

aiden (Infra): Option C needs headcount we don't have; A seems realistic.

priority-bot: quick poll opened: "Q2 sequencing: choose priority order" (react with 1/2/3)

elaine (PM): proposal: go with Option A, scope Pinning as MVP, pair Eng + Design for a 3-week cadence, follow with Batching next quarter. fallback: if legal relaxes, we can re-evaluate.

matt (Eng): +1. put a hard launch criteria: Pinning launch if we can demonstrate per-org routing and audit logs + no latency regression (p95 <= current + 10ms) in canary.

sophia (Design): +1 on criteria. I'll draft the admin UI copy and audit export flows.

jason (Product Ops): I'll notify sales/legal and get Acme deadline formalized.

elaine (PM): ok — next steps: 1) scope doc for Pinning MVP (due EOD Thurs), 2) engineering spikes for Batching (run in parallel low-priority), 3) infra impact assessment for Prefetch (deferred).

matt (Eng): logging note: add telemetry to track pin usage + performance delta (event + tag).

elaine (PM): thanks all. if no objections by EOD we'll lock Option A and start sprint planning. :thumbsup:

jason (Product Ops): no objections from me.

aiden (Infra): no objections.

sophia (Design): no objections.

matt (Eng): sounds good.

priority-bot: poll closed — result: Option A (Model Pinning first) majority.

elaine (PM): filing quick follow-up doc and assigning owners.
